actors.name: HR Department
actors.private_context: HR wants a high completion rate for the engagement survey. They have sent reminders and will monitor progress.

actors.name: Employees (400)
actors.private_context: Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and tendency to complete or ignore optional surveys. They may or may not notice reminders.

shared_context: Calloway Regional Hospital has 400 employees. The annual engagement survey is open from 2026-09-01T08:00:00-05:00 to 2026-09-15T17:00:00-05:00. Employees can complete it online via a link sent by HR. HR has sent an initial email with the survey link and will send reminders during the period.

starting_events.description: The annual engagement survey opens. HR sends an email with the survey link to all 400 employees.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 employees submitted a completed survey before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
